what_this_is: Every Indianapolis decision this revalidation could not make on evidence alone, in ONE grouped packet. Nothing here has been applied. Where a prior founder ruling already settles the shape of an answer, that precedent is named so the decision is a confirmation rather than a fresh invention.

decisions.subject: la quinta inn indianapolis airport lynhurst -- 5316 West Southern Avenue, 46241
decisions.question: Is this identity the same building now trading as Baymont by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport Lynhurst?
evidence: the committed La Quinta slug no longer resolves: it soft-404s to the Wyndham Indianapolis brand list
Wyndham's current Indianapolis inventory lists 5316 W. Southern Ave, Indianapolis, Indiana 46241 as 'Baymont by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport Lynhurst', telephone +1-317-982-5719
the successor page states the census street and postal exactly and retains the 'Lynhurst' locality qualifier
the La Quinta brand list for Indianapolis names four properties and none is at this address
the telephone changed (census 317-247-4281 -> 317-982-5719), which is ordinary for a franchise rebrand
decisions.recommendation: SAME_IDENTITY_REBRAND_SUCCESSOR. Keep the census identity_key, add a markets/name_corrections row showing 'Baymont by Wyndham Indianapolis Airport Lynhurst', and rebind the official URL -- exactly the shape of IDR-012-006 (Wyndham Indianapolis West -> Wyndham Indianapolis Airport), which you have already ruled once.
decisions.census_effect: none -- no row is added or retired; the identity survives under its committed key
decisions.authority_effect: admits one PUBLISHED_PET_FRIENDLY row (2 pets max, dogs only, 45 lbs or less per dog, 25 USD per pet per night) whose policy is already captured
decisions.routing_effect: replaces a dead slug with a live first-party property URL
decisions.reversibility: fully reversible -- an overlay row and a URL, no census mutation
decisions.blocks_promotion: NO, provided the row stays out of promotion until ruled

this row's census street and telephone are 2244 East Perry Road and 317-837-9000, neither of which appears on the page
order 012 already established that 6010 Gateway Drive is the Baymont and 6300 is the Wingate

decisions.subject: The 14 census identities whose canonical name is a bare chain word
decisions.question: May a bare chain word ever reach a published page?
decisions.detail: aloft, candlewood suites, comfort suites, fairfield inn and suites, hampton by hilton, hyatt house, mainstay suites, marblehead, microtel, motel 6, quality inn and suites, sonesta select, towneplace suites -- plus 'home2 suites by hilton', which the overlay already covers.
evidence: exactly one bare-brand identity is published today ('tru') and it already carries a name_corrections row, so there is no live display defect
the remaining 13 are all unresolved, so none can reach a page while unresolved
'sonesta select' is in this revalidation's clean inventory and would be the first uncorrected bare name to publish
decisions.recommendation: Confirm the standing rule set by order 018: no bare chain word publishes without a name_corrections row citing the property's own page. Apply it to 'sonesta select' ('Sonesta Select Indianapolis Carmel', stated on the property page) as part of any promotion.
decisions.census_effect: none -- the overlay never rekeys the census
decisions.authority_effect: none directly; it gates what a reader is shown
decisions.blocks_promotion: YES for 'sonesta select' specifically, and for any other bare-brand row a future order tries to promote

decisions.subject: Same-address pairs that are almost certainly legitimate dual-brand campuses
decisions.detail: 601 West Washington Street (Courtyard + SpringHill, both already VERIFIED_NO_PETS); 9765 North by Northeast Boulevard (Fairfield + Residence Inn); 9780 North by Northeast Boulevard (Comfort Inn + Staybridge); 2244 East Main Street (Cambria + Hampton Inn SW Plainfield, the latter published); 11455 North Allisonville Road (Homewood Suites + Hyatt Place Fishers); 11575 Commercial Drive ('hampton by hilton' + the published 'hampton inn and suites indianapolis fishers'); 5815 Rockville Road ('microtel' + the excluded 'microtel inn and suites by wyndham indianapolis'); 2311 North Shadeland Avenue; 3525 North Shadeland Avenue; 3880 West 92nd Street; 8229 East US Highway 36
decisions.question: Confirm that shared address alone continues NOT to merge identities, and that the two bare-brand members ('hampton by hilton', 'microtel') are aliases of their published/excluded full-named neighbours.
evidence: no collision group currently has two RESOLVED members generating routes, so none of these produces a duplicate live route today

'hampton by hilton' shares an address AND a brand family with a PUBLISHED row; 'microtel' shares an address AND a brand family with an EXCLUDED row -- these two are the strongest alias candidates in the market
the collision gate of order 004 explicitly deferred all of these, on the rule that an unresolved row may stay unresolved while it cannot create a duplicate live route
decisions.recommendation: Keep the standing rule. Rule 'hampton by hilton' and 'microtel' ALIAS_OF_EXISTING and retire them with lineage; leave the genuine dual-brand campuses as SAME_CAMPUS_DISTINCT_ENTITY.
decisions.census_effect: 263 -> 261 if the two aliases are retired
decisions.blocks_promotion: NO today, but it becomes blocking the moment any order tries to promote a second member of one of these pairs

decisions.subject: home2 suites by hilton indianapolis keystone crossing -- the live published record understates its own founder-signed evidence
decisions.question: Should the live record be corrected to carry the facts PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-HOME2-KEYSTONE-REPARSE-014 recovered and you signed?
evidence: the reparse ledger recovered, from artifact 8313f175..., the statement 'Yes, pets are allowed at Home2 Suites by Hilton Indianapolis Keystone Crossing. There is a $75.00 non-refundable fee for pets up to 75 lbs. For stays of 1-4 nights, the fee is $75. For stays of 5 or more nights, the fee is $125.', occurring three times in that artifact
you signed it on 2026-08-27 (founder_signature_014, APPROVED_AFTER_CURRENT_REVIEW) and the policy package names that ledger in its derived_from
the live record nevertheless carries facts {pets_allowed: true} and nothing else, with the quote 'pets allowed'
the live record's projection_notes assert 'pet_fee: SOURCE_SILENT', which the same artifact contradicts
it is the only one of the 67 published records whose sole fact is pets_allowed
decisions.recommendation: Correct the record in a later promotion order: carry the recovered statement as the pets_allowed quote and add the 75 lb weight limit and the 75/125 USD fee tiers. This is a projection defect, not a wrong fact -- pets ARE allowed -- but a guest reading the page today sees no fee where the hotel charges 75 to 125 USD.
decisions.authority_effect: one existing published record gains its withheld facts; the count does not move
decisions.blocks_promotion: NO -- but it is the single highest-value correctness item this revalidation found in the LIVE authority

decisions.subject: Eight census rows are classified AWAITING_OFFICIAL_URL while already carrying a property-specific official URL
decisions.detail: comfort inn east indianapolis, echo suites extended stay by wyndham indianapolis ameriplex, extended stay america indianapolis castleton, quality inn noblesville indianapolis, wingate by wyndham indianapolis airport plainfield, woodspring suites indianapolis airport south, woodspring suites indianapolis castleton, wyndham indianapolis west
decisions.question: Confirm this is a partition bookkeeping defect and not a deliberate withholding of those routes.
evidence: each of the eight carries an official_url that names a single property
each is nevertheless told to 'Find and bind this property's own official page'
all eight were stamped determined_by PTF-INDIANAPOLIS-PROMOTION-AND-ASSEMBLY-014 with an empty state_override_reason
five of the eight were resolved from those very URLs in this run at zero cost, which would not have been possible had the routes been absent
decisions.recommendation: Treat as a partition classification defect. A later order should reclassify the eight to the state their evidence supports. It cost this market a free acquisition pass: the rows looked unroutable and were skipped.
decisions.authority_effect: none directly -- but it hid five publishable rows
decisions.routing_effect: eight rows regain a correctly-labelled route
